source_lineage: Both KIIS versions are issuer-prepared platform-hosted documents; repeat values do not constitute independent corroboration.
facts: Campaign financial-promotion approval dates are different typed observations from displayed Funded dates.
2024 and2025 KIIS repeat the same2019–2023 Completion date and amount values.
KIIS2020–2024 date observations precede campaign Funded dates by27–36 days and are0–3 days after approval.

hypotheses_not_findings: Previous campaigns Completion date may reflect a platform metadata mapping or an earlier campaign milestone. No reviewed source confirms this.
Campaign raise totals may include commitments/cancelled investments or use a different cut-off from KIIS amount raised. No reviewed source confirms this.
prohibited_inferences: Do not rename KIIS dates launch/approval/close without evidence.
Do not treat KIIS as automatically superior merely because newer.
Do not silently equate Funded display with security delivery or independently operating state.
Do not demand a private individual investor contract universally; sufficient native aggregate evidence may support stagewise round admission.
next_evidence: Public platform documentation defining the historical previous-campaign Completion date field and displayed Funded date.

Index-specific comparability, entry independence and event/observation review under the approved estimator target.
mapping_boundary: KIIS table has no campaign IDs. Every pair and its difference arithmetic is conditional on candidate issuer/year/sequence linkage; exact same-economic-round correspondence remains a G1 review.
